title: FX Moment: Dollar-Yen Bearish Push Needs US Data Validation Next
summary: In this episode of the FX Moment podcast, Bloomberg Intelligence Chief FX Strategist Audrey Childe-Freeman and Chris Turner, head of FX strategy at ING Bank in London, discuss dollar-yen near- and mid-term dynamics. The combined shift in the dollar view following the July 29 Fed meeting, stretched long positioning and joint US-Japan FX intervention were the perfect catalysts for a sharp move lower in dollar-yen, yet the market is already questioning whether the move can be sustained. summary: The yen’s rally stalled Tuesday even as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent pledged continued support for Japan following a historic joint intervention.

title: Apollo Invests $1 Billion in Joint Venture With Starwood REIT
summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. is investing $1.02 billion in a joint venture with Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, a commercial property vehicle known as SREIT that has struggled to provide liquidity to investors.

title: Prudential Tops Estimates as Revenue From Asset Manager Soars
summary: Prudential Financial Inc. reported second-quarter results that beat Wall Street estimates as revenue from its asset manager surged.

title: Most Emerging-Market FX Gains as Oil Dips Below $80 Per Barrel
summary: Most emerging-market currencies gained on Tuesday, rebounding from an earlier selloff amid optimism the US and Iran are nearing a deal to restart peace talks.

title: US Revokes Brazilian Ambassador’s Visa Amid Diplomatic Spat
summary: The Trump administration revoked the visa for Brazil’s ambassador to the US after the country delayed giving diplomatic approval to Washington’s choice for envoy to Brasilia, a senior State Department official said Tuesday.

title: Codelco Halts Expansion Work at Top Mine on New Seismic Risk
summary: Codelco is suspending work on a project designed to extend the life of its biggest copper mine in Chile after identifying a new source of seismic risk a year after a rock burst killed six workers.

title: S&P 500 Rises to All-Time High on Hormuz Deal Push: Markets Wrap

title: Situational Awareness Not Target of Predatory Shorts, S3 Says
summary: The losses that forced hedge fund Situational Awareness to sell stocks at deep discounts appear to be the result of highly concentrated positions in crowded trades, rather than a concerted effort by short-sellers, according to the founder of a company that analyzes short positioning data.

title: Tanger Sees Boost from World Cup, Back to School Shoppers
summary: Tanger Inc. boosted its outlook for a second time this year, as stronger domestic travel and early back-to-school shoppers have boosted traffic and sales at the real estate investment trust’s shopping centers.

summary: One of the most dramatic foreign exchange market interventions in decades aims to stabilize the slumping yen — and stave off a larger crisis.

title: AbbVie Sees Strong Demand for Its $10 Billion M&A Bond Sale
summary: Investors flocked to drugmaker AbbVie Inc.’s $10 billion investment-grade bond sale after signs of investor fatigue for new debt to fund artificial intelligence efforts.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 4
summary: Oil slid to the lowest in over three weeks as optimism grew that the US and Iran are moving closer to an agreement that would reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz chokepoint.

title: Cerberus Seeks $4 Billion for Second Supply Chain Fund
summary: Cerberus Capital Management, co-founded by Deputy Secretary of Defense Stephen Feinberg, is looking to raise at least $4 billion for its latest supply-chain fund that backs investments critical to the US economy.

title: Jefferies Gets New Evidence of Fake Invoices at Troubled Fund
summary: Jeffries has found new evidence that invoices underpinning its financing to an iron ore trader called Sapphire Minmetals Corp. are fake. This discovery comes after Jeffries was already reviewing its exposure to iron ore trader Radiant World, after reports that documents provided to financers were not valid. Bloomberg's Sri Natarajan reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wayfair Sees Momentum as Stores, High-End Goods Draw Consumers
summary: Kate Gulliver, CFO at Wayfair, said that the momentum the furniture company is seeing is the result of initiatives building up over time as Wayfair tries to improve the customer experience. Gulliver also discussed what kind of consumers are buying from Wayfair. She said that the company is seeing momentum from the higher-end consumer with the inclusion of a premium brand 'Perigold' and is drawing in new customers with brick-and-mortar stores.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Treasuries Rise as Falling Oil Prices Ease Pressure on Fed
summary: Treasuries rose on Tuesday as signs of progress toward a diplomatic resolution of the Iran war sent oil prices lower, curbing expectations for more than one Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in the coming year.

title: Jefferies Gets Evidence of Fake Invoices at Trouble Fund
summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. has been told that some of the invoices underpinning its financing to an iron ore trader called Sapphire Minmetals Corp. are not genuine, according to people familiar with the matter. Sapphire Minmetals denies the "rumors." Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
